init_hf_model_local: initialize a HuggingFace causal language model with auto device mapping and float16 precision
init_vlmhf_remote_model: initialize a VLMHFModel connected to a remote language model server via host and port
generate_response: generate an autoregressive text response from a prompt using local HF or remote RLM inference
generate_rlm_batch: generate multiple batch responses from a remote language model with configurable temperature and stop words
get_logprobs: get the log probabilities of generated text sequences from HF or RLM batch responses
